queries.transport: SELECT n.value AS task_type,k.isMaster,k.transportType,k.linkType,COUNT(*) AS calls,SUM(t.endNs-t.startNs)/1e9 AS seconds,SUM(k.size) AS task_bytes FROM COMMUNICATION_TASK_INFO k JOIN COMMUNICATION_OP o ON o.opId=k.opId JOIN TASK t ON t.globalTaskId=k.globalTaskId JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=k.taskType JOIN STRING_IDS a ON a.id=o.opType WHERE a.value='hcom_reduceScatter_' GROUP BY n.value,k.isMaster,k.transportType,k.linkType ORDER BY seconds DESC LIMIT 20
queries.comm_ids: SELECT COUNT(*) AS calls,COUNT(DISTINCT connectionId) AS unique_ids,MIN(connectionId) AS min_id,MAX(connectionId) AS max_id FROM COMMUNICATION_OP
queries.cann_ids: SELECT n.value AS name,COUNT(*) AS calls,COUNT(DISTINCT a.connectionId) AS unique_ids,MIN(a.connectionId) AS min_id,MAX(a.connectionId) AS max_id FROM CANN_API a JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=a.name WHERE n.value LIKE '%reduceScatter%' GROUP BY n.value ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 20
queries.connection_ids_schema: SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='CONNECTION_IDS' ORDER BY name LIMIT 1
queries.host_schema: SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='PYTORCH_API' ORDER BY name LIMIT 1
queries.op_samples: SELECT o.opId,n.value AS op_name,o.connectionId,o.startNs,o.endNs,o.count FROM COMMUNICATION_OP o JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=o.opName JOIN STRING_IDS a ON a.id=o.opType WHERE a.value='hcom_reduceScatter_' ORDER BY o.startNs LIMIT 6
queries.cann_samples: SELECT a.connectionId,a.startNs,a.endNs,a.globalTid FROM CANN_API a JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=a.name WHERE n.value='hcom_reduceScatter_' ORDER BY a.startNs LIMIT 6

connection_ids_schema.sql: CREATE TABLE CONNECTION_IDS (id INTEGER, connectionId INTEGER)

host_schema.sql: CREATE TABLE PYTORCH_API (startNs TEXT, endNs TEXT, globalTid INTEGER, connectionId INTEGER, name INTEGER, sequenceNumber INTEGER, fwdThreadId INTEGER, inputDtypes INTEGER, inputShapes INTEGER, callchainId INTEGER, type INTEGER)

limits: Host/device linkage must be verified; task byte sums are not unique physical traffic.
